auto_fail_flags.label: Coach treated as champion
auto_fail_flags.description: The seller calls a person a champion without showing that the person has budget, sign-off, or access.

auto_fail_flags.label: Paper process lag ignored
auto_fail_flags.description: The seller never probed the paper process, so legal, procurement, and security lag stays unknown.

artifact: Verified MEDDPICC scorecard with verbatim buyer citations

transition_banner.title: Qualify before you pitch.
transition_banner.body: Every deal starts with proof from the buyer, not with your notes.

drills.title: Metrics and economic buyer
drills.prompt: Ask what success looks like in numbers, then ask who owns the budget and who signs the PO.

drills.title: Decision criteria and process
drills.prompt: Find out how they will score vendors, then walk through the approval path step by step.

drills.title: Champion and paper process
drills.prompt: Test whether your champion will carry the deal internally, then map legal, procurement, and security lead times.

boss_fight.title: Boss fight · Qualification gauntlet
boss_fight.learner_brief: Qualify a Tier-1 deal end to end with three buyers. Every signal must reach verbatim buyer proof.
